title: Admission through UPTAC Counselling 2026-27 - AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE
text: Admission through UPTAC Counselling 2026-27 Admission through UPTAC Counselling 2026-27 AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE, GHAZIABAD Physical Reporting Instructions for the candidates who have been allotted our college through Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling – 2026 and have Frozen their choices as one of the Courses / Branches in AKGEC during UPTAC Counselling – 2026. Reporting is the process of completion of admission formalities by submitting requisite fees and documents at College in accordance with the terms and conditions stated in the Allotment Letter of UPTAC-2026 and as specified hereunder: 1. The Candidates are required to bring the following original documents for verification, along with their photocopies, in the specified order when physically reporting at the college for admission. List of Documents: (Click to download the documents) 2. During the physical reporting at the college, candidates are required to fill out the admission form provided by the institute. Additionally, candidates must download the specified documents, complete them by hand, and personally submit the documents to the college authorities along with the admission form. a) Admission Form(click to download) b) MIS Form(click to download) c) Application Form for Student ID Card (click to download) d) Undertaking (Fee Related) (click to download) e) Undertaking (Attendance) (click to download) f) Transport Form (If required) (click to download) g) Anti-Ragging Undertaking (Self and Parents). (click on link mentioned below) It is mandatory for all students to submit the Anti-ragging Undertaking form online through the web portal https://antiragging.in/affidavit_affiliated_form.php Both the Student undertaking and Student/Parents undertaking need to be signed and submitted to the college. For filling in the College details in the anti-ragging undertaking form, please use the below data. Educational Institution Type Affiliated College State Uttar Pradesh College Name Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, Ghaziabad Director Name Dr. Hemant Ahuja College Phone Number 8744052891 to 94, 7290034976, 7290034978 Nearest Police Station to your College Wave City Thana, Ghaziabad 3. For Fee Details : (click to download the fee structure) Those applying for educational loans may use the documents placed at serial numbers 1-4. 1. Approval Letter issued by the AICTE (click to download) 2. Affiliation Letter issued by the University 3. Provisional Fee Details For Bank Loan Purpose Note [Very Important]: a) The college has limited hostel facilities for boys, but there is sufficient hostel accommodation available for girls. The criterion for the allotment of the hostel shall be the exclusive right of the Director of the college. b) Although the original documents shall be returned after due verification at the time of reporting at College but all students should mandatorily keep the original documents with themselves during I semester. c) Kindly visit the college website at regular intervals for updates related to reporting and the commencement of the session. For any query regarding physical reporting, please call Mr. Ashok Joshi (Dy. Registrar) at 9350259532 & Mr. Tapendra Singh Chauhan (Asst.
